asset_set: Questionnaire Q19 option 1 — Fixing electric bicycles

questionnaire.question_text: Which repair work would you prefer?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under battery pack and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle brushed-metal lines on battery casing via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: curious maker energy — approachable e-mobility repair, not risky electrical work
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
brand logos on battery or tools
sparking exposed wires, fire, or explosion

accent.name: KursoKo teal
accent.use: battery indicator LEDs, mechanic sleeve cuff trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: teal appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on battery casing edge and probe tip
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under battery pack and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: holds the battery housing open and steady
left_hand.grip: cupped palm supporting the casing edge
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: touches a multimeter probe to a battery lead
right_hand.grip: precision pinch on the probe handle

pose.gesture_summary: mid-diagnostic freeze frame — probe touching lead as the LED confirms charge
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: both hands — fingertips exposed for dexterity

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands holds an e-bike battery housing open while the other touches a multimeter probe to a lead, watching for the confirming teal indicator glow. The scene reads as satisfying hands-on repair, not risky electrical work.

primary_objects.name: e-bike battery pack
primary_objects.detail: open housing revealing cell rows, two small teal LED indicator dots

primary_objects.name: multimeter probes
primary_objects.detail: teal and lavender probe tips, one touching a lead

primary_objects.name: repair stand clamp
primary_objects.detail: simple clamp arm edge, no bike frame fully shown

subject.environment: bike repair stand edge strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, workshop suggestion only

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from hex key set → battery pack → probe hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: midground: battery pack and hex key set
composition.thumbnail_readability: battery silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter R, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, sparking exposed wires, fire, explosion, guns, blood
